upstream_artifact.identity_evidence: Each local CSV's CRLF-normalized Git blob matches the file at the pinned VoT commit. Per-file SHA-256 and blob IDs are recorded in data/source_manifest.json.
upstream_artifact.interpretation_limit: This proves copied-artifact identity only. It does not prove how VoT obtained, selected, transformed, aggregated, or revised the original observations.

paper_reference.title: Time-MMD: Multi-Domain Multimodal Dataset for Time Series Analysis

evaluation_policy.source_hash_rule: Verified HIC memory and query must carry the same plan-pinned source_sha256.

official_source_checks.confirmed: USDA ERS defines both wholesale and retail broiler composites in cents per retail pound and defines wholesale-to-retail spread as retail value minus wholesale value. The independently bounded fit-prefix audit found all 233 comparable fit rows satisfy OT = Wholesale broiler composite + Retail-wholesale spread for broiler composite within 1e-6 tolerance, supporting the retail-composite interpretation for that prefix.
official_source_checks.reason_not_upgraded: The fit-prefix arithmetic supports the formula but does not prove the exact upstream ERS download, source revision/vintage, seasonal-adjustment status, or that the same mapping holds outside the audited fit prefix. The full-series follow-up read is separately recorded as an exposure and is not used to promote this contract.

official_source_checks.confirmed: The Census page labels the series U.S. trade in goods with the World, monthly, not seasonally adjusted; values are nominal millions of U.S. dollars and include exports, imports, and balance.
official_source_checks.reason_not_upgraded: The existing local audit found 374/423 OT values equal Exports minus Imports and 49 differ by at most 0.1; the local source vintage, rounding/transform, and mapping to the paper's three-dimensional target remain unresolved.

official_source_checks.confirmed: EIA publishes weekly retail gasoline prices by U.S. and regional areas in dollars per gallon, including taxes; the national regular-gasoline series has a documented EIA series identifier.
official_source_checks.reason_not_upgraded: The local OT column has not been matched to the national EIA series ID or a documented transformation; the paper's nine-dimensional target mapping is unresolved.

official_source_checks.confirmed: OpenFEMA exposes multiple disaster, assistance, public-assistance, hazard-mitigation, and grants datasets through downloads and an API.
official_source_checks.reason_not_upgraded: The generic local OT schema does not identify which FEMA dataset, measure, unit, aggregation, or vintage produced the series.

official_source_checks.confirmed: BLS states that API retrieval requires the exact series ID; series identifiers encode survey-specific metadata, so a generic unemployment label is not enough to identify a series.
official_source_checks.reason_not_upgraded: The local artifact has no verified BLS series ID, population/group definition, seasonal-adjustment status, unit, or explanation for the 892-versus-900 row difference.

fit_prefix_reconciliation.scope: native 64% fit prefix only; no validation or outer-test OT values

datasets.evidence_and_gaps: The native 64% fit prefix supports OT = wholesale broiler composite + retail-wholesale spread, consistent with the USDA ERS retail broiler composite definition and cents-per-retail-pound unit. The mapping remains partial because the exact upstream ERS artifact/revision, seasonal-adjustment status, and full source lineage are not proven. A later full-file read is logged as target exposure and is not used as clean confirmation or to promote this mapping.

time_mmd_reference.provider_named_in_paper: NOAA NCEI; numeric source link is drought.gov

datasets.evidence_and_gaps: The local VoT artifact is a single OT series; the paper describes a five-dimensional drought target. In an independent NOAA NCEI Climate at a Glance check, all 314 local monthly OT values from 1983-01 through 2009-02 matched the displayed contiguous-U.S. precipitation 1-Month/All Months values exactly at 0.01-inch precision. This strongly supports the local precipitation/inches interpretation, but does not prove the original download field or transformation lineage. Keep the paper-target mapping as conflict; do not call this the paper's unchanged Drought Level series. The same NOAA page also exposed March-December 2009 values; see data/external_reference_exposure_ledger_20261019.json.

The local file has 423 rows; 374 OT values equal Exports minus Imports within floating-point tolerance, while 49 differ by at most 0.1. This supports a trade-balance relationship, but does not settle the difference, units, seasonal adjustment, source vintage, or mapping from the local scalar OT to the paper's three-dimensional target.

supporting_fields: eight named regional retail gasoline price series in dollars per gallon

datasets.evidence_and_gaps: The local file contains OT and eight clearly labeled regional price columns, consistent with a nine-value gasoline-price family. The exact meaning of OT (for example, national series or another aggregate), its exact EIA series ID, and the paper-to-local column mapping have not been verified.

time_mmd_reference.provider_named_in_paper: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

datasets.evidence_and_gaps: The local CSV contains multiple plausible ILI measures and subgroup fields; in an inspected row, OT differs from % WEIGHTED ILI. The HIC loader forecasts only OT, while the paper describes an 11-dimensional target. Exact OT definition, geography/group aggregation, denominator, and mapping to the paper are unresolved.
The local schema contains only generic OT plus dates/text fields. The name, measure, unit, aggregation rule, FEMA dataset/table, and source vintage are not identifiable from the local schema alone.

The domain, single target dimension, and monthly cadence are plausible matches, but the local series has 892 rows versus 900 in the paper table. Exact BLS series ID, population/group definition, unit, seasonal adjustment, missing-period explanation, and revision vintage are unresolved.

This file is not one of the nine Table 1 Time-MMD targets. Its timestamps are irregular and the local schema does not identify OT's measurement, unit, entity, aggregation, or original provider. Keep it as a separately named local series; do not map it to the paper's Environment or Climate target by theme.
